name: Zendikar
description: Zendikar is a wild adventure plane of volatile mana, floating hedrons and the shifting Roil, home to Nissa Revane and Nahiri and the site of the Eldrazi prison.

bio.text: Zendikar is a dangerous world of ruins, treasures and expeditions, where the Roil redraws the land as it passes and only hedrons stay unchanged.

citations.text: Harrow (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
Zendikar: card flavor text (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Long ago Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin Markov chose Nahiri's Zendikar for its lush ecosystems and dynamic mana as a prison for the Eldrazi, with Sorin luring them, Ugin binding them and Nahiri building the hedron network.

citations.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: Over the millennia the Eldrazi stirred, vampires destabilized the prison at one point, and Nahiri restored it alone before leaving.

citations.text: "Nahiri", section "Guarding Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

bio.text: Nahiri also trapped Ob Nixilis there with a hedron, and he spent centuries plotting revenge.

citations.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Trapped". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

bio.text: Nissa, who had bonded with Zendikar's living soul, shattered the main hedron at the Eye of Ugin and freed the Eldrazi titans, and Ob Nixilis later destroyed the hedron ring and awakened Kozilek.

citations.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.
"Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Battle for Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Eldrazi overran regions such as Sejiri, Bala Ged and Sea Gate, until Jace, Gideon, Chandra and Nissa swore an oath to form the Gatewatch and Chandra burned Ulamog and Kozilek through the leylines.

citations.text: "The Battle for Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.
"Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chandra Nalaar", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Years later Nahiri returned and used the Lithoform Core to rid the plane of the Roil, but Nissa prevailed and used the Core to heal Zendikar.

citations.text: "Zendikar Rising", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nahiri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Phyrexian invasion the compleated Nahiri turned the Emeria Skyclave into an engine and Sea Gate fell again, until Tazri's party broke her loose and the Skyclave crashed down with her inside.

citations.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Zendikar (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: After the invasion Zendikar lay wrecked and covered in Phyrexian metal, with a desparked Nahiri unable to restore the land and vowing that no planeswalkers would set foot there again.

citations.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair

timeline.summary: Nahiri desparks Ob Nixilis with a hedron and traps him on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: desparks Nixilis with a hedron and traps him on Zendikar

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa breaks the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin, freeing the Eldrazi Titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa breaking the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Joraga chief Numa decides to send the animists away.
timeline.quote: Numa was adamant about sending them away because of the danger to the tribe.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Believing Numa right, Nissa slips out of her home before her mother can notice.
timeline.quote: Nissa packed her staff-sword and bow and slipped out of the house before her mother could notice.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The narrator reveals the card is Nissa Revane, a proud and ruthless nature-mage from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This is Nissa Revane, a proud and ruthless nature-mage.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator and a climbing partner reach the largest field of floating ruins in Akoum, which the narrator and their father had sought.
timeline.quote: You're standing on the largest field of floating ruins in Akoum, perhaps in all of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Monument to a Lost Age". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The kor travel nomadically across Zendikar hunting mikunga on the Roil-churned winds, connecting to their surroundings with lines and hooks.
timeline.quote: The kor follow a nomadic lifestyle, chasing the winds across Zendikar, hunting the mikunga

citation.text: "The Master at Arms". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zahr Gada warns that lost fingers and toes are nothing compared to the lost treasures of Sejiri.
timeline.quote: Trust me, your lost fingers and toes are nothing compared to the lost treasures of Sejiri.

citation.text: Brave the Elements (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane asks why fight the world when you know who will win.
timeline.quote: Why fight the world when you know who will win?

citation.text: World Queller (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zendikar's volatile mana makes spectacular spells and astonishing failures.
timeline.quote: Zendikar's volatile mana is the basis for many spectacular spells

citation.text: Cancel (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zurdi, caught in a lethargy trap, stops caring about treasure and the circling drakes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, Zurdi didn't care about treasure, glory, food

citation.text: Lethargy Trap (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Most Zendikar inhabitants give up on an accurate map as seas spread.
timeline.quote: Most inhabitants of Zendikar have given up on the idea of an accurate map.

citation.text: Spreading Seas (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov criticizes vampires who gorge without savoring the kill.
timeline.quote: The vampires of this world don't know the pleasures of hunger.

citation.text: Feast of Blood (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen, having lost his spark, plots revenge on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

citation.text: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar says the land of Zendikar seems to go out of its way to kill you.
timeline.quote: The land here seems to go out of its way to kill you.

citation.text: Seismic Shudder (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elves hold that Nissa will save only those who prove their worth.
timeline.quote: Nissa will save the elves, but only the ones who have proved their worth.

citation.text: Nissa's Chosen (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only hedrons unchanged.
timeline.quote: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

citation.text: Harrow (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane declares the forest's blood beholden to no one.
timeline.quote: The blood of the forest is beholden to no one.

citation.text: Tanglesap (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chadir the Navigator scorns planar-walkers who do not know wild.
timeline.quote: Those brazen 'planar-walkers' have no idea what wild really means.

citation.text: Vastwood Gorger (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anowon seeks the fingerprints of oppressors in bloodstains.
timeline.quote: In these bloodstains I will find the fingerprints of our oppressors.

citation.text: Carnage Altar (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ayli says gods do not die, they merely slumber, beside the Eldrazi monument.
timeline.quote: Gods don't die. They merely slumber.

citation.text: Eldrazi Monument (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zendikar's angels try to resist the first stirring of the Eldrazi but are defeated and wear their halos over their eyes.
timeline.quote: The angels were among the first creatures that attempted to mount a resistance against the first stirring of the Eldrazi but were easily defeated.

citation.text: "Angel", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When the Eldrazi titans are released again, the halos of oppression shatter and the angels fight and mostly die.
timeline.quote: The angels fought, and mostly, they died.

citation.text: "Angel", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace rips the Eye of Ugin's location from Anowon's mind.
timeline.quote: Jace ripped the information he sought from the vampire's mind

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ancient kor empire of Zendikar falls one by one to rebellions, civil wars and the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: One by one they fell to rebellions, civil wars, and eventually the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zendikar is established as a new plane, previously only alluded to in the Planeswalker novel The Purifying Fire.
timeline.quote: had been alluded to within the Planeswalker novel of The Purifying Fire

citation.text: "Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that the Kor's appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: It is revealed that their appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.

citation.text: "Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza visits Zendikar hoping hedron magic could stop Phyrexia but abandons the idea.
timeline.quote: He deemed the matrix's power insufficient, and so, he abandoned this idea.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Urza's visit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zendikar's mages and adventurers set out on wilderness expeditions seeking the magical moment of discovery.
timeline.quote: they're looking to experience that crackling, magical, life-changing moment of discovery.

citation.text: "The Moment of Discovery". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Oct 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An avatar of retribution wreaks havoc at the new Makindi Trenches outpost Moliq built, killing hundreds.
timeline.quote: enraged at the audacity of his fledgling community, wreaked havoc there, killing hundreds and teaching Moliq a harsh lesson in allegiance and humility.

citation.text: "Ally Cuisine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Radrik, disillusioned and envious of his sister Ayli, leaves her and joins an expedition to Jwar Isle.
timeline.quote: Disillusioned and envious, Radrik stopped traveling with his sister and joined up with an expedition to Jwar Isle

citation.text: "Ally Cuisine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thairin leads successful forays into the floating islands off Tazeem.
timeline.quote: Thairin has been called "the Conquer or" for his leadership during successful forays into the archipelago of floating islands along the coast of Tazeem.

citation.text: "Ally Cuisine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Dronn loots a fallen trench ogre's axe, ignores warnings it is too big and has a second forged.
timeline.quote: When Dronn looted the axe of a fallen trench ogre, not only did he ignore the advice that the weapon was too big for him, he also had a second one forged identical to the first.

citation.text: "Ally Cuisine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thraur escapes Kazuul's slave-warriors at the Cliffs of Kazuul and vows never to return.
timeline.quote: As a rule, Kazuul's slaves never escape; but Thraur is an exception to that rule.

citation.text: "Ally Cuisine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tawny survives a disastrous encounter with a Bala Ged yellow ooze, its companions slain, and returns to base camp carrying the party's prize Everflowing Chalice.
timeline.quote: "Tawny" was the only survivor of a disastrous run-in with a Bala Ged yellow ooze

citation.text: "Ally Cuisine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator laments that Zendikar has come alive and turned against adventurers, forcing a start over.
timeline.quote: Zendikar itself has come alive.

citation.work: The Look of an Awakening World
citation.text: "The Look of an Awakening World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator learns a tectonic plate is shambling toward their main equipment cache in Tazeem, dooming it.
timeline.quote: now I hear there's suddenly a tectonic plate shambling its way across the area

citation.work: The Look of an Awakening World
citation.text: "The Look of an Awakening World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator's intended lair site becomes an elemental and goes off to terrorize some kor.
timeline.quote: the lair site got up

citation.work: The Look of an Awakening World
citation.text: "The Look of an Awakening World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator's elf guide leaves to become one of Nissa Revane's Chosen.
timeline.quote: Ever since my elf guide left me to become one of her Chosen

citation.work: The Look of an Awakening World
citation.text: "The Look of an Awakening World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ancient forces on Zendikar begin to awaken, causing the world to wreak havoc on its inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Ancient forces begin to awaken, causing the world of Zendikar to wreak havoc upon its inhabitants.

citation.text: "Worldwake", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thousands of years ago three Eldrazi descend on Zendikar and spawn brood lineages to pillage it.
timeline.quote: Thousands of years ago, three Eldrazi monstrosities descended on Zendikar

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ugin, a lithomancer and Sorin Markov trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with a lock-spell at the Eye of Ugin and leave.
timeline.quote: the planeswalkers trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zendikar survives and slowly recovers as the brood lineages die off and the colossi fall inert.
timeline.quote: The brood lineages died off and the Eldrazi colossi fell inert

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that merfolk deities Cosi and Ula derive from dim memories of Kozilek and Ulamog, so the Eldrazi came before religion.
timeline.quote: the merfolk deities Cosi and Ula are derived from dim memories of Kozilek and Ulamog

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The protagonist and minotaur find the dragon enchanted and defeat it.
timeline.quote: You and your minotaur companion have taken down the Mordant Dragon that plagued the residents of Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A necromantic vision shows an amber orb as the source of influence on the dragon.
timeline.quote: There's one symbol that stands out lucidly in your mind: a fist-sized orb of amber, golden and translucent as fire.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The protagonist calls on Zendikar's elementals and defeats the dragonmaster.
timeline.quote: The dragonmaster—and her vendetta against you—lie defeated.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
timeline.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are lured to Zendikar and lulled into torpor by the hedron prison; centuries later they rise again and obliterate the land and the living.
timeline.quote: But when the abominations rose again several centuries later, Zendikar was unprepared for their assault

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Angels try to resist the Eldrazi but their resistance is cut through.
timeline.quote: Archangels drew their swords and stood between the Eldrazi and the land of Zendikar

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi leave halos on the angels worn down over their eyes, blinding them and keeping them from interfering.
timeline.quote: Each angel's halo is worn down over her eyes, symbolizing her mystical blindness to the Eldrazi's atrocities

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zendikar's people mistake the halos for impartiality, and the angelic Emeria is conceptualized from the silhouette of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: And the terrible silhouette of Emrakul against the sky became Emeria, a vision of salvation on white-feathered wings.

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Iona and a few greater archangels keep their sight and fight the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: To this day Iona fights to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi forces that would devour it

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The halos of oppression have shattered, heralding a new generation of freed angels such as Linvala.
timeline.quote: It may be in the spirit of that defiance that the halos of oppression have shattered.

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi titans are lured out of the aether and bound to Zendikar for thousands of years.
timeline.quote: luring the Eldrazi titans out of the aether and binding them to a world for thousands of years

citation.text: "Rise of the Inbox". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi materialize on Zendikar and their brood lineages spring up around the three titans.
timeline.quote: Even when they materialized into Zendikar, their bizarre forms still had no particular resonance with any of the five colors

citation.text: "Rise of the Inbox". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The hedrons coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures, forcing the griffins to seek new territory.
timeline.quote: As the hedrons began to coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures

citation.text: Makindi Griffin (Rise of the Eldrazi, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kozilek's lineage spreads death by death.
timeline.quote: Death by death, Kozilek's lineage spread.

citation.text: Spawning Breath (Rise of the Eldrazi, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anowon discovers Chandra has a physical map and tries to kill her; Sarkhan Vol knocks him out.
timeline.quote: He soon discovered that Nalaar actually possessed a physical map and so tried to kill her.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren finds Anowon feeding off his guide, disables him, reads his mind, and persuades him to lead him to the Eye.
timeline.quote: Anowon attacked Jace, but the mind mage disabled him and read his mind

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anowon betrays Chandra and tries to kill her in her sleep; Sarkhan knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Luckily for Chandra, Sarkhan Vol ambushed Anowon, rendering him unconscious with a swift strike to the head.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov, Ugin and Nahiri decide to rid the Multiverse of the Eldrazi; Ugin helps imprison them on Zendikar instead.
timeline.quote: Ugin told them that it wouldn't be a good idea to destroy them and instead helped them imprison the Eldrazi on the plane of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Three against three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic and Nahiri's hedron network forms the prison bars.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane, directing their hunger to that unique mana

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa shatters the main Hedron and releases the enchantment imprisoning the titans, and Sorin washes his hands of her.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise and build a hedron and leyline network on Zendikar to trap the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Titans arrive at Zendikar in -1400 AR and the three planeswalkers fight them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a trap network of leylines, hedrons and mana nodes on Zendikar, with Nahiri building it and Ugin inscribing runes.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's inhabitants as the Eldrazi approach in -1400 AR, and the three titans descend upon Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek, and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane releases the titans, and Kozilek's brood is said to retreat to remote corners of the world.
timeline.quote: After the release of the titans Emrakul , Ulamog , and Kozilek by Nissa Revane

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kozilek emerges from deep underground after Ob Nixilis drains the hedron network imprisoning Ulamog.
timeline.quote: Kozilek emerged from deep underground nearby.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Three plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin lures them, Ugin binds them and Nahiri builds the hedron prison.
timeline.quote: Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The imprisonment succeeds, The Three disband, and Sorin and Ugin leave, promising to come if Nahiri signals.
timeline.quote: With the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi , the planeswalkers' mission was complete, and The Three disbanded.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri binds Ob Nixilis's power with a hedron before he can do much damage.
timeline.quote: Nahiri intervened and bound his power with that of a hedron

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Guarding Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine at the hedron nexus, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri wakes, calls unanswered for help and restores it alone.
timeline.quote: She succeeded on her own in restoring the prison.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Guarding Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi brood attacks the Tajuru meeting and kills Sutina.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi brood attacked the meeting and killed Sutina shortly after it began

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov arrives in time to save Nissa from the brood.
timeline.quote: Nissa would have fallen to the brood herself if not for the timely arrival of Sorin Markov

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Kozilek's awakening Noyan Dar is the last roil mage standing and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Dar was the last roil mage standing

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri intercepts Ob Nixilis on Zendikar and fuses a hedron into his forehead, binding his spark and trapping him.
timeline.quote: This hedron bound his spark , trapping him on the plane

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Trapped". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace takes Nixilis's lure, strikes him down and extracts the hedron to save Garruk, restoring Nixilis's strength.
timeline.quote: Thus Ob Nixilis regained his strength and could regrow his wings.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Trapped". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi, long imprisoned on Zendikar, are released, making the plane's perils deadlier.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi have been released.

citation.text: "Rise of the Eldrazi", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Sarkhan deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.
timeline.quote: Enter the Eldrazi is a webcomic about Jace and Sarkhan as they deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.

citation.text: "Rise of the Eldrazi", section "Webcomic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin allies with Nahiri and Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers imprisoned them

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri lure and imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar for 6,000 years.
timeline.quote: The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi caused the three Titans to become trapped in the plane for 6,000 years.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "The Three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with leylines and hedrons.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi titans arrive on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: descended upon Zendikar, their monstrous forms dwarfing everything in their path.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twelve surviving cultists become the first vampire bloodchiefs, enslaved to Ulamog.
timeline.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reinforces the prison on her own and leaves; the vampires are freed of Ulamog's yoke.
timeline.quote: After Nahiri enforced the Eldrazi prison all on her own, no more broods came to life.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Chandra, Sarkhan and Nissa's actions free the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: freed the Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Three decide to trap the Eldrazi on a plane and choose Nahiri's Zendikar for its lush ecosystems and dynamic mana.
timeline.quote: They decided on Nahiri's own Zendikar .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic, and Nahiri builds the hedron network that forms their prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three legendary Eldrazi trapped on Zendikar rise again, each spawning a brood lineage of minions.
timeline.quote: have risen again.

citation.text: "The Three Brood Lineages". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The old master tells his students that the reason for their training is now clear: the Eldrazi threat has come, and they must wage war against them.
timeline.quote: Now you wage war against the Eldrazi, and show them what beings of this world are capable of.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Worldwake: Zendikar rages at the approach of something dire and expeditions are swallowed by land elementals and zendikons.
timeline.quote: Expeditions became swallowed by land elementals, zendikons, and other hunks of revenge-thirsting terrain.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi arrive on Zendikar, killing people where they stand and leaving no safe pockets of civilization.
timeline.quote: Instead of simply failing to return from dangerous safaris in exotic wildernesses, people are being snuffed where they stand.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Adventurers abandon treasure hunting and prepare to fight the Eldrazi, with the levelers rising to stand against them.
timeline.quote: Rise of the Eldrazi 's "levelers" are adventurers who've taken it upon themselves to stand up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With the Eldrazi already eating the gates, someone pumps Zendikar's heroes full of mana to rush their growth.
timeline.quote: So someone—perhaps a handful of ancient teacher-types, perhaps planeswalkers, perhaps Zendikar itself—is pumping the world's heroes full of mana to rush the process.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: thousands of years ago the Eldrazi first awoke from torpor and nearly destroyed the natural world while humanoids did not slow them.
timeline.quote: Thousands of years ago when the Eldrazi first awoke from their torpor, the destruction was vast; the natural world nearly perished at the touch of a tentacle.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas was active on Zendikar through his instrument Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: he was active there through his instrument Sarkhan the Mad

citation.text: "What Is Flavor?". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The native peoples of Zendikar, the Kor, merfolk and vampires, try to understand the Eldrazi and how to defeat them.
timeline.quote: The Kor, merfolk, and vampires all tried to understand and figure out what the Eldrazi were and how could they defeat them.

citation.text: "First Week's Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi arise once more on Zendikar, and the merfolk realize they had mistaken the Eldrazi names for the legends of gods.
timeline.quote: But as the Eldrazi arose once more, the merfolk came to understand their mistake.

citation.text: "Auratouched Magery". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The columnist explains that Zendikari are unlikely to have understood any Eldrazi communication, so the Eldrazi did not introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi consciousness is too alien, too starkly different for our forms of language to latch on to their forms of awareness.

citation.text: "Auratouched Magery". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zendikar is conceived as a high-adventure world.
timeline.quote: we began to think of Zendikar as a high-adventure world of daring explorers and exotic locales

citation.text: "Theme-Driven Worldbuilding". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With the Helvault sundered, Nahiri returns to a ravaged Zendikar and swears vengeance on Sorin.
timeline.quote: she swore vengeance against Sorin

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, embittered, planeswalks to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away to her home world of Zendikar

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Consequences". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon recalls having seen Zendikar devoured and decides he is needed on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: He was needed here.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
timeline.quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Hamadi calls Nissa 'Shaya' as they climb a mountain together.
timeline.quote: I think highly of your will, Shaya,

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa how his people of Graypelt were destroyed by the Eldrazi, and Nissa, overcome by guilt, apologizes.
timeline.quote: She was responsible for all of it, all his loss and all of Zendikar's devastation.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
timeline.quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
timeline.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Nissa frees herself and rides vines down to the ground to fight the Pathrazer, which crushes several travelers.
timeline.quote: Before anyone could act, the Pathrazer had grabbed several of the expedition and crushed them in its tentacled hand.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Khali and Sha'heel snare the Pathrazer with ropes while Nissa pours all her power into earth elementals that crush it.
timeline.quote: the other two hulks bludgeoned the Pathrazer into a wriggling mass of unrecognizable flesh.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa that Zendikar has chosen her and that Shaya means Worldwaker.
timeline.quote: It means 'Worldwaker.'

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin arranges the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy.
timeline.quote: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy.

citation.text: Perilous Vault (Magic 2015, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With Jace's help, Chandra casts a fire spell that cannot be seen and brings down the transformed Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: With his encouragement, she cast a fire spell that could not be seen

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Awakenings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's brood attacks the Joraga and Nissa barely survives as their only survivor, saved by Hamadi's band.
timeline.quote: Nissa had barely survived, a band of humans saving her, apparently the only survivor of the Joraga tribe.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Worldwaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An elemental that does not return to the land becomes Nissa's companion, Ashaya.
timeline.quote: It became her companion

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Worldwaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis broods over his two defeats, the first taking his body and the second his spark, and the folly of seeking the Veil.
timeline.quote: The first robbed me of my body. The second of my spark.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Deep underground, Ob Nixilis rotates the hedrons on the cavern walls and casts spells, testing their runes.
timeline.quote: He rotated a hedron a few degrees and spoke a brief incantation.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
timeline.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ob Nixilis was drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse but was attacked and bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped his curse but crippled him.
timeline.quote: I couldn't even scream as she bound the hedron into me.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As the passage crushes in around him, Ob Nixilis drains the stone's vitality and digs toward a green glow.
timeline.quote: He bought himself a moment by bracing himself between the walls, and he muttered a spell.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reveals that the bound hedron took his power and that his wings fell off, leaving him small and weak, and vows revenge.
timeline.quote: The thing she put inside me made me small. Weak.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis studies the hedrons for centuries and lures planeswalkers, letting word of his condition spread until a proud planeswalker comes to extract the hedron.
timeline.quote: And sure enough, some arrogant child finally took my lure.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reaches the glowing source in the depths and takes a flower of green and gold power from a tiny sphere of life, laughing.
timeline.quote: It radiated power, warmth, and health.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.
timeline.quote: My spark is within reach.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Bolas treated him as a mere pawn and dismissed him as a dragon's toy.
timeline.quote: I am dismissed, a dragon's toy, tossed aside and useless.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri decides that Zendikar will be the Eldrazi's prison and she their jailer, and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer, one world and one Planeswalker standing steadfast to protect all others.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Over forty years, Nahiri pulls hedrons from the earth and Ugin etches them with runes, creating a trap and a lure for the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It took forty years of near-constant work.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's peoples of the coming Eldrazi as the titans slowly approach the hedron-lit plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri spread word throughout the plane of what was coming

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin traps the Eldrazi on Zendikar, learning little from Sorin but the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin

citation.text: Ugin's Construct (Ugin's Fate, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi stir and Nahiri wakes from her long slumber, a thousand years before the great reawakening.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi stirred. Nahiri woke.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits the hedron network's sites, burying the Eldrazi broods she finds, and determines she must stop them alone.
timeline.quote: But she was alone, and she would do it alone.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: A shimmering stream like the one in her vision appears and wraps around Nissa like a cocoon; she connects with Zendikar's soul.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane connected with Zendikar.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Mazik finds Nissa and reveals he followed her with her mother's knowledge; Nissa realizes Zendikar is in pain and wants her help.
timeline.quote: Zendikar isn't after me.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Mazik follow the stream out of the forest and across the canyons, running short of water.
timeline.quote: Together, they followed the stream of glowing light deeper into the forest.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Vampires attack in the bog and Nissa leads Mazik to flight along the stream, but Mazik is separated and trapped in a tree.
timeline.quote: Five vampiric horrors loped after them.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa unexpectedly summons a huge land elemental, controls it, and kills the vampire leader with vines.
timeline.quote: they pierced the vampire straight through his heart.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the Roil is Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calms the land by humming her mother's animist song.
timeline.quote: It was an animist song, the tune that her mother had hummed to her so many times.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Zendikar forms an elemental from the land to guide Nissa and Mazik to the dark knot.
timeline.quote: a fully formed elemental stepped out of the earth.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa channels Zendikar's power in a massive blast at the mountain but it has no effect.
timeline.quote: it was as though her spell had done nothing.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills an Eldrazi monstrosity on Zendikar with a shard of hedron after a hard fight.
timeline.quote: Hedron connected with boney faceplate.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
timeline.quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: A mage collapses the cliffs with lightning along Munda's iron spikes, burying the Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: sheets of white stone tumbled toward the Eldrazi below.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes Zendikar is in pain rather than vengeful.
timeline.quote: I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me.

citation.text: Zendikar's Roil (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa's people angered Zendikar and faced its wrath.
timeline.quote: Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath.

citation.text: Zendikar Incarnate (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mimicking Ashaya's gesture, Nissa sees glowing leylines stream from her fingers and understands Zendikar did not choose her but she is one with it.
timeline.quote: These were the leylines

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she was never chosen or alone but one with Zendikar and cries 'For Zendikar!', charging into the forest bonded to the land.
timeline.quote: "For Zendikar!" she cried

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya are struck by terrible pain as the connection to Zendikar is torn away, and Ashaya collapses and shatters.
timeline.quote: Nissa watched as Ashaya's branches snapped and shattered on the ground.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes in silence, unable to feel Zendikar or Ashaya, and stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: But there was nothing there to grasp.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon is welcomed at the encampment with the rescued survivors while Nissa reaches out and finds Zendikar silent and empty.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was empty.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace meets Jori En, who offers her knowledge of the hedron research, and Jace reads her mind instead.
timeline.quote: "I have a better idea, if you're amenable."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Jori's memories of Kendrin's team and her death to the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She had died to the Eldrazi slaughter before she could pass on enough of what she knew.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
timeline.quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori set out for the Eye without Gideon and discuss whether Jace changed her mind or Gideon's.
timeline.quote: They rode out from the encampment—without Gideon.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi spawn attack Jace and Jori's coach, and the hurda panics.
timeline.quote: When the swarm of Eldrazi spawn crested the hill

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: The kor woman Ayli rescues them, killing the hurda as bait, and leads them into a chasm.
timeline.quote: sliced through the hurda's neck with one of the sharp hooks.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
timeline.quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace uses an illusion to make the Pilgrims believe they are on fire, and he and Jori escape.
timeline.quote: "Stop," said Jace, and the man burst into flames.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace alters Jori's mind to make her think she chose to return, and she walks on toward Sea Gate, cursing him.
timeline.quote: "God damn it, Jace."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa keeps vigil each twilight at the bluff where Zendikar was torn from her, finding only emptiness.
timeline.quote: She kept vigil there, returning each day to ground herself

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Pili's insistence that she knew inspires Nissa to realize Zendikar's soul may have retreated to Khalni Heart.
timeline.quote: If something had happened, if the titan had threatened the world's soul, that's where it would have run to.

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
timeline.quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora finds an altar to the Three in a cave and spits in Ula's face before sleeping beneath Cosi's statue.
timeline.quote: And she spit in Ula's blank, stupid face.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora uses the bident and sea creatures to drive Eldrazi off a hundred merfolk refugees.
timeline.quote: A vortex formed near one of the Eldrazi, sending it tumbling.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora reunites with her sister Turi, who tells her Kozilek and Emrakul have not been seen for months and that Ulamog is at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "No one's seen him in months," she said.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
timeline.quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells a Cosi story about a mortal who steals Ula's spear, calling a wave that parts around the merfolk.
timeline.quote: A great wave broke over and around her

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora promises Turi she will return, and half a dozen of Cosi's devotees follow her on a serpent toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: And half a dozen of the merfolk quietly came and stood beside her.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar turns from lulling Zendikar to rousing its fury.
timeline.quote: After many years as a lullmage, Noyan Dar turned his talents from allaying Zendikar's fury to the considerably easier task of rousing it.

citation.text: Noyan Dar, Roil Shaper (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa's connection to Zendikar is restored.
timeline.quote: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

citation.text: Nissa's Renewal (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Ulamog destroys Bala Ged, an unnamed Malakir vampire gives Nissa seeds of Zendikar's plants on Anowon's behalf.
timeline.quote: The vampire beseeched her to take the seeds and plant them on another plane.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Gift to Nissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin Markov use hedrons to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together with Ugin and Sorin Markov she used them to trap the horrendous Eldrazi on the plane.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa releases the Eldrazi, thinking they would leave Zendikar behind; she is wrong.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi were finally released by the elf Nissa Revane , thinking that they would leave Zendikar far behind them.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers facing the Eldrazi, while Ob Nixilis seeks a way off the plane.
timeline.quote: Now, Gideon Jura takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers in facing the Eldrazi alongside the residents of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa, Chandra, Gideon and Jace swear an oath to stand together and form the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon manipulates Noyan Dar into joining the retaking of Sea Gate by exploiting his hubris.
timeline.quote: Gideon had used his hubris against him as manipulation to get him to offer his help

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis summons Kozilek and defeats Jace, Nissa and Gideon, capturing and torturing them until Chandra frees them.
timeline.quote: He summoned Kozilek and defeated Jace, Nissa, and Gideon.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis frees Kozilek and reignites his spark.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis used his newfound power to coax the second Eldrazi Titan, Kozilek, from its hiding spot

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis captures and tortures Gideon, Jace and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis then took Gideon, Jace, and Nissa prisoner, took them to a cave, and tortured them.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra frees her friends and scares Ob Nixilis away.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar showed up and freed her friends.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A serpent swallows Kiora and Turi's exploration; Kiora distracts it, her spark ignites, and she promises Turi to return home.
timeline.quote: In that moment of boiling panic, her planeswalker's spark ignited.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Jace then activated the hedron's magics and trapped Ulamog.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reignites his spark with the hedron magic and escapes Zendikar.
timeline.quote: which reignited his planeswalker's spark and allowed him to escape from Zendikar

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis coaxes Kozilek out from under the plane's crust.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis used his newfound power to coax the second Eldrazi Titan, Kozilek, from its hiding spot under the plane's crust.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa bests Ob Nixilis at Bala Ged and removes the Khalni Heart to safety.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Tazeem Ob Nixilis siphons the hedron network, reigniting his spark, destroys it and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: he destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis defeats Nissa and breaks Jace's cheekbone at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the demon's glancing blow broke Jace's cheekbone and sent him sprawling.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon shreds one of the demon's wings; Nixilis pins and drowns him in muddy water.
timeline.quote: Nixilis then proved that invulnerability was nothing as he proceeded to drown Gideon in the muddy waters at their feet.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nixilis takes Gideon, Jace and Nissa prisoner and tortures them until Chandra frees them and their attack scares him away from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Their concerted attack managed to scare the demon away from Zendikar

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to Zendikar, allying with Nissa and freeing Anowon to reach the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: he liberated the vampiric slave Anowon and demanded that the two take him to the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals his mission and nature to Nissa on the voyage to Akoum.
timeline.quote: Sorin finally told Nissa the nature of their mission, as well as admitting to being a walker much like her.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa persuades Brinelin to lead them through the crystal reefs by telling him of Sutina's death.
timeline.quote: Brinelin finally acquiesced to lead them safely through the crystal reefs.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa shatters the main hedron at the Eye of Ugin, releasing the Eldrazi, and Sorin washes his hands of her and Zendikar.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri survives Zendikar's Last Stand in which the Gatewatch defeat the titans, and leads rebuilding.
timeline.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin warns Jace about the hedron network and berates the Gatewatch for killing Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: Ugin berated them for killing the ancient creatures instead of trapping them

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul and Kozilek vanish six months after release, leaving Ulamog to ravage Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Six months after they had been released, both Emrakul and Kozilek vanished, only leaving a few spawn behind.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace dominates Jori En's mind to send her back to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.
timeline.quote: Jace dominated Jori En's mind to force her to leave him and return to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Within two years Sea Gate, Sejiri and Bala Ged are overrun in the Battle for Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate on Tazeem and the entire continents of Sejiri and Bala Ged were overrun

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she is neither her old self nor her controlled self and pours her essence into Khalni Heart, letting it root in the land.
timeline.quote: Nissa collected all the power left within her

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The land swallows Khalni Heart and Zendikar's soul returns to the land, defeating the demon's plan.
timeline.quote: The world's soul had returned to the land.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks to Zendikar for just one peek and lands near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: She pressed her will against the whereness around her, forcing it to change.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A scout on a manta nearly spots Chandra, who runs into three Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: she was face-to-faceplate with a trio of angular, meaty-ribbed, bony-headed creatures.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra kills the three Eldrazi with fire.
timeline.quote: creating a tripartite blade of fire that sliced through each one of them.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
timeline.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Zendikar, defends the Zendikari, faces a titan and leaves to seek reinforcements on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Vowing to return, he left in search of aid at the center of Planeswalker activity: the city-world of Ravnica.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons Lorthos, who appears as a vast darkness, and she pleads with him to fight the interlopers.
timeline.quote: She summoned, and he came!

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Kozilek repeatedly resurrects and kills Gideon for amusement.
timeline.quote: Another twitch, another ripple , and Gideon Jura was reborn again

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: after Kozilek leaves, Tazri spends ten thousand years trying to recreate Zendikar, and then billions of years in sleep waiting for him.
timeline.quote: For the first ten thousand years after Kozilek's disappearance, Tazri had used her new powers to attempt the reconstruction.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri tells herself the story of the day Gideon died through the dead cosmos.
timeline.quote: This is the story of the day Gideon died.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The halo shields Tazri's mind, and she meets the angel she killed in a white void outside time.
timeline.quote: We are outside of time, Tazri.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri refuses to be healed, saying the sacrifice was hers, and the angel tells her she is forgiven and that Zendikar can win.
timeline.quote: You can win. You will win. There is no other option.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace and Gideon call planeswalkers to stay and fight, founding the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: But Gideon's right: we're also the ones who can choose to stay.

citation.text: Call the Gatewatch (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace discovers the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek, which Nissa traces on her world.
timeline.quote: Jace discovered the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek to reality, but it was Nissa who could trace it on her world.

citation.text: Bonds of Mortality (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Nissa carve a path through the Eldrazi swarm.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

citation.text: Lead by Example (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds back the brood lineages while Chandra incinerates the bound titans.
timeline.quote: As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: Fall of the Titans (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures hellions into the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Chandra used jets of flame to lure hellions into the path of oncoming Eldrazi.

citation.text: Cinder Hellion (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis is surprised by Chandra.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had prepared for every eventuality—except Chandra Nalaar.

citation.text: Devour in Flames (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace asks himself what Gideon would say to inspire an army.
timeline.quote: Faced with the novel problem of inspiring an army, Jace asked himself: "What would Gideon say?"

citation.text: Unity of Purpose (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch members swear their oaths to keep watch.
timeline.quote: For justice and peace, I will keep watch.

citation.text: Oath of Gideon (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at the Battle for Zendikar and frees Gideon, Jace and Nissa from Ob Nixilis, scaring the demon off.
timeline.quote: She managed to free them, and through a concerted attack they finally scared the demon away from the plane.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The four Planeswalkers swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Channeling her flame through Zendikar's ley lines, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin confronts Jace, furious the titans were killed, and warns of unknown consequences.
timeline.quote: Ugin arrived and confronted Jace, furious that the titans had been killed despite his warning.

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Gideon resolve to leave Zendikar to gather intelligence, while Nissa stays as its guardian.
timeline.quote: Nissa committed to staying on Zendikar as its guardian.

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace plans to kill the titans by binding Kozilek and Ulamog to Zendikar with a leyline pattern, using defenders as bait.
timeline.quote: Jace decided to slay the titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora 's help.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra channels fire through the leylines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek; Ugin is angered.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant stroke of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis traps Gideon, Jace, and Nissa while seeking the Eldrazi's power; Chandra frees them and they drive him from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar arrived in time to free her fellow planeswalkers, and together they forced Ob Nixilis to flee Zendikar.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Nissa devise a plan to destroy the titans permanently, breaking Jace's promise to Ugin.
timeline.quote: Jace and Nissa devised a plan to destroy Kozilek and Ulamog permanently

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Chandra's massive fire spell the Gatewatch kills the Eldrazi titans in Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Helped by a massive fire spell of Chandra, they succeeded.
