citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin berates Jace and his friends for killing the ancient creatures.
timeline.quote: Jace and his friends were berated by Ugin for killing the ancient creatures

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers swear an oath and found the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and founded the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns Ulamog and Kozilek through the ley lines, destroying both titans.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Gideon, Chandra and Nissa swear an oath, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog and Kozilek are incinerated by Chandra's flames channeled through Nissa.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Jace trap Ulamog with the hedrons until Ob Nixilis destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: He destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En finds the wounded Kiora and they retrieve her bident.
timeline.quote: Jori En found the wounded Kiora amidst a mass of dead sea creatures.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiora urges releasing the titans but Chandra burns them through Nissa's ley lines, destroying Ulamog and Kozilek; Kiora leaves alone.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds Ulamog and Kozilek in a web of leylines and burns them, ending Kozilek's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Kozilek on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds and frees Nissa, Jace and Gideon from Ob Nixilis's cave.
timeline.quote: Luckily, Chandra Nalaar had arrived on Zendikar, found the trio, and freed them.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The four swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was realized.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linked with Nissa, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa plants the seeds of Bala Ged's native plants.
timeline.quote: Nissa planted the seeds of Bala Ged that she had once received from the vampire straggler

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa form the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: swear oaths to save the planes together, forming the Gatewatch .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch destroys Kozilek and Ulamog.
timeline.quote: the Gatewatch defeats Kozilek and Ulamog .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa leaves the Gatewatch and planeswalks to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nissa leaves the Gatewatch and planeswalks to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: General Tazri is saved by her halo and takes command of the regrouped forces.
timeline.quote: General Tazri was saved by the protection of her halo.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra frees her friends, they scare Ob Nixilis from Zendikar and swear an oath, creating the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus, they swore an oath to stand together, and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch and Kiora, devising a leyline plan with Nissa and using defenders as bait.
timeline.quote: Jace decided to slay the Titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora's help.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra channels fire through Nissa and the ley lines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon's dented buckler in the mud and recalls her parents' deaths on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: It was a large buckler shield, wedged in a depression of mud.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
timeline.quote: The demon took him, and two others.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
timeline.quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace stops Gideon from making empty promises to a distraught Nissa.
timeline.quote: Don't make promises you can't keep,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, and Nissa refuses and the ground trembles.
timeline.quote: I'm not going anywhere,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But maybe four of us can,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa swears the oath to keep watch.
timeline.quote: for the life of every plane, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace swears the oath, warning that Emrakul could be drifting through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra swears the oath, saying every world has its tyrants, and Nissa embraces her.
timeline.quote: If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
timeline.quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace presents half a plan with the glyph that Ugin showed him, since a hedron trap for two titans is impossible.
timeline.quote: It's no longer possible to trap Kozilek and Ulamog,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace proposes using the army as bait to bring the titans together, and Tazri says bait does not get a choice.
timeline.quote: The titans are drawn to concentrations of life,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
timeline.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa shares her mind and memories with Jace, showing how the hedron network contained the titans and how the Roil was the world fighting back.
timeline.quote: She'd thought her world was angry. She hadn't realized it was fighting for its life.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Jace conceive a plan to drain the titans' energy into Zendikar's leylines without hedrons, so the plane can devour them.
timeline.quote: So this world can do to them what they 've been trying to do to it.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
timeline.quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Jace he trusts him despite the demon's warning about telepaths.
timeline.quote: I trust you,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace rallies the rear guard troops with Nissa, telling them they are the most important people on the battlefield.
timeline.quote: She'll be binding the titans, and ultimately she'll be the one who kills them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
timeline.quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri compares Zendikar's bleeding to what Innistrad and Sorin will suffer.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad. As I have wept, so will Sorin.

citation.text: Structural Distortion (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks home to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her feet found the rocky earth of Zendikar, and for the first time since her imprisonment began, she stood on solid ground.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
timeline.quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi

citation.text: Hedron Matrix (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels overwhelmed and alone among the crowds of Ravnica, cut off from Zendikar's voice.
timeline.quote: She'd never been among so many, and never been so alone.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis vows revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time.
timeline.storyline: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
timeline.quote: I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time.

citation.series: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
citation.text: Altar's Reap (Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis speaks the word of Zendikar's doom.
timeline.storyline: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
timeline.quote: The doom of Zendikar was here at last.

citation.series: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
citation.text: Doom Blade (Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa now gathers forces to defend all of Zendikar.
timeline.storyline: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
timeline.quote: Now, she gathers forces to defend all of Zendikar.

citation.series: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
citation.text: Nissa's Chosen (Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akiri leaves her kor band after an Eldrazi attack kills her comrades.
timeline.quote: she struck out on her own when an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: A lone missionary marches a pilgrimage through outposts struck by the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar

citation.text: Lone Missionary (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Some vampires remind others of their loyalty after the awakening of the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: After the awakening of the Eldrazi, some vampires took it upon themselves to remind the others where their loyalty should lie.

citation.text: Inquisition of Kozilek (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vampires fought the Eldrazi and many learned to live among humans.
timeline.quote: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans.

citation.text: Vampire Nighthawk (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane asks to be shown how to help Zendikar.
timeline.quote: "I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."

citation.text: Elemental Bond (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the Eldrazi spread, Zendikar's defenders seek any secret that could give them an advantage.
timeline.quote: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

citation.text: Painful Truths (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Ugin and Nahiri imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi are imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin, Ugin , and Nahiri .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An intruder declares Zendikar will be his throne, palace, and playground once intruders are gone.
timeline.quote: "When these intruders are gone, Zendikar will be my throne, my palace, my playground."

citation.text: Infernal Reckoning (Core Set 2019, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin flees through Zendikar, Kephalai and Ravnica with Bolas in pursuit, wounded by his venomous magic.
timeline.quote: From bustling Kephalai to growing Ravnica and on and on, he flees with Nicol breathing down his neck

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Elves find a use for every part of the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It wasn't long until the elves had developed a use for every part of the Eldrazi.

citation.text: Momentous Fall (Commander 2019, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa takes the Lithoform Core from Nahiri and revitalizes Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nissa takes the Core from Nahiri, activating it and revitalizing the plane.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Jace that Zendikar is her world, down to its bones.
timeline.quote: "This is my world, Jace, down to its very bones."

citation.text: Nahiri's Binding (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The death of the Eldrazi did not still the Roil.
timeline.quote: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

citation.text: Into the Roil (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri ignored Nissa's warnings and repeated history by lithoforming.
timeline.quote: Heedless of Nissa's warnings, Nahiri repeated history.

citation.text: Lithoform Blight (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares that it is time for her home to know peace.
timeline.quote: "Zendikar has suffered enough. It is time, at last, for my home to know peace."

citation.text: Nahiri's Lithoforming (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The ruins awakened and their defenses with them.
timeline.quote: When the ruins awakened, so did their defenses.

citation.text: Ancient Greenwarden (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zendikar begins healing and Nissa flies home to Bala Ged; Jace finds the Core's power gone.
timeline.quote: As Jace picked up the Lithoform Core, he found that its power was gone.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri hires adventurers and uses the Lithoform Core, killing Zareth and pushing Akiri off the ruin.
timeline.quote: Nahiri used the artifact to defend herself but killed Zareth in the process.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core to heal Zendikar and restore its wild nature, and Nahiri swears revenge on Jace.
timeline.quote: Nissa had used the power of the Lithoform Core to heal the damage done by the Eldrazi and restore Zendikar's wild nature

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's disregard for Zendikar's soul and her killing of an elemental friend turn Nissa against her.
timeline.quote: prompted the elf to turn against her

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the Core has undone the damage and Zendikar is healing.
timeline.quote: It had undone the damage to the plane.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kor Empire collapses and each Skyclave falls in a different way, from the Roil, rebellion, a sea beast, civil war, Kargan dragons, Iona, and an Eldrazi titan.
timeline.quote: over a century, the empire fractured and ultimately collapsed

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The fall of the Skyclaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane uses the Lithoform Core's healing power, accelerating the continent's recovery.
timeline.quote: the recovery of the continent was accelerated

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adventurers awaken the Emeria Skyclave and the other six, which rise back into the sky.
timeline.quote: all seven Skyclaves rose back into the air and opened

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa clash over how to end the Roil, and Nissa prevails, restoring Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: In the end, Nissa Revane prevailed, and restored the soil and wild nature of Zendikar by use of the Lithoform Core .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri returns to Zendikar, determined to rid it of the Roil.
timeline.quote: Nahiri has returned to Zendikar, and is willing to do anything to get rid of the Roil.

citation.text: "Zendikar Rising", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa also returns to Zendikar, for reasons of her own.
timeline.quote: Nissa has also returned home, but for reasons of her own.

citation.text: "Zendikar Rising", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Nissa foments an elven rebellion against the kor.
timeline.quote: Nissa fomented an elven rebellion against the kor.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The explosion destroys the Singing City; Zendikar begins visibly healing and Nissa discards the Core and departs.
timeline.quote: The explosion destroyed the Singing City

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nissa show Zendikar's forests and a Skyclave, and Nahiri vows to wake the weapon.
timeline.quote: I can wake it once more to enact our will.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri departs for Zendikar.
timeline.quote: In three steps, she winks out of existence

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri smothers the Roil's attacks, reducing the landscape to bedrock.
timeline.quote: Eventually the earth quiets.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
timeline.quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's rage shatters hedrons into burning ruin.
timeline.quote: Nahiri's rage shattered hedrons into deadly, burning ruin.

citation.text: Lithomantic Barrage (March of the Machine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tries to bend Zendikar to Phyrexia's will, and the world rises against her.
timeline.quote: Nahiri tried to bend Zendikar to Phyrexia's will. In response, the world rose against her.

citation.text: Awakened Skyclave (March of the Machine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Roil rises against Phyrexian infection on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Roil, Zendikar's planewide immune system, rose in full force against the threat of Phyrexian infection.

citation.text: Rugged Highlands (March of the Machine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the New Phyrexian Invasion begins, Kiora returns to Zendikar to defend it and later loses her spark in the Great Desparkening.
timeline.quote: she lost her spark in the Great Desparkening .

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiora explores new seas across the Omenpaths but cannot find a route back to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: when she tried to find a route back to Zendikar, she was unable

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn sends compleated Nahiri to conquer Zendikar; she reactivates the Emeria Skyclave and realigns the hedrons to call Realmbreaker, fusing with the stones.
timeline.quote: she fused herself with the stones in the center, becoming its keystone

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri's party, empowered by Halo, breaks Nahiri loose and the Skyclave crashes with her inside.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave broke and crashed to the ground with her still inside

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri is foiled by Akiri's party on Zendikar after compleating elementals.
timeline.quote: but was foiled by Akiri and her party

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The compleated Nahiri transforms the Emeria Skyclave into a Phyrexian engine and realigns the hedrons for Realmbreaker; Sea Gate falls again.
timeline.quote: As Phyrexians scurried into Zendikar, Sea Gate was defeated once more.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
